FN-6HJ6313-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 116
Committee: Boards, Agencies and Sponsor: Representative Matt Simpson
Commissions
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 02/12/2025
House Bill 116 as introduced provides for the continuance of the Alabama Professional Bail
Bonding Board until October 1, 2027 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. This bill will not
otherwise affect state or local funding.
